findings.title: Preserve the narrower task-status type
findings.description: `TaskFileResult.inferredStatus` is described as having only three possible values; task files cannot be `deprecated`. Retyping it to the full `NormalizedStatus` union admits a state the field cannot represent, weakening its compile-time contract. The literal sweep does not require that widening: derive a three-value task-status type from `STATUS` (for example, excluding `STATUS.Deprecated`) so the values remain centralized while the field stays precise.

findings.title: Trim verification and procedural detail for a mechanical refactor
findings.description: This is a no-behavior-change sweep, but the design repeats file-by-file work and test instructions across its scope, migration plan, success criteria, and verification walkthrough; the task breakdown also specifies those steps in detail. Cut the duplicated procedural instructions, the temporary typo-and-revert exercise, and the live CLI spot-check. Keep the literal-count check, build, and regression test suite as verification appropriate to the change.
